summary_ja: CVAリスクに係る外部ヘッジ取引および内部取引（内部CVAヘッジ取引）のマーケット・リスク相当額計測対象の取扱いを規定し、適格CVAヘッジ取引の計測除外、非適格の場合の相殺処理、CVAデスクとトレーディング・デスク間の内部取引の利用可能性を定める条文。
summary_en: Governs the market risk equivalent measurement treatment of external CVA hedge transactions and internal CVA hedge transactions, excluding qualifying CVA hedges from measurement, requiring offset of non-qualifying internal CVA positions, and permitting CVA desk internal transactions to serve as credit exposure hedges when specified conditions are met.
